facts.business: Shree Marutinandan Tubes Limited manufactures steel pipes and tubes and operates a fire protection systems business through a joint venture.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Completion and commissioning of manufacturing infrastructure in respect of which capital work-in-progress of Rs. 632.50 lakh stood capitalised as at March 31, 2026, thereby enabling a measure of forward integration and margin improvement
Scaling up of the fire protection systems business through the Joint Venture and leveraging of trade secrets, technical know-how and business contact networks acquired during the year
Widening of the geographical footprint of the distribution network
Continued strengthening of the balance sheet, including through the conversion of the outstanding Fully Convertible Warrants

auditor.name: S. K. Jha & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: General market, macroeconomic, governmental and regulatory trends
Movements in currency exchange and interest rates
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include office rent, director remuneration, unsecured loans availed/repaid, salary, sitting fees, sale, factory rent, and purchase with directors, KMPs, relatives, and entities where KMP has control/significant influence.
